##### Project general facts

Luma21 is an unparalleled residential development, offering exceptional value for its price range. These ace apartments come in various sizes, combining convenience, beauty, and state-of-the-art amenities for living life in style. Designed for a community of busy professionals and families, vibrant, light-filled spaces offer picturesque views of centrally located private gardens, creating the ideal living space where every detail is crafted to enhance modern living.

Flourish in a community of wonderful people and delightful amenities, then retreat to your new cosy home. The interior design matches the exterior splendour of the building, with plenty of finishing touches designed to add to your enjoyment. Modern bathrooms reflect thoughtfulness in their everyday use, from built-in shelving and roomy drawers and cabinets to polished tile surrounding the shower. Studios and full-sized apartments offer options for bedrooms and styles to fit your needs.

Every residence at Luma21 features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. The interiors are designed with attention to detail, creating spaces that are both functional and inviting. Cosy, spacious, and with all the amenities you're looking for, Luma21 outperforms every other apartment building in the neighbourhood, making it a perfect match for busy professionals, couples, and young families ready to find their element.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, one of Dubai's most sought-after housing options, this exceptional location is popular among both potential tenants and investors. The community features a diverse range of housing options from villas and townhouses to studio flats and multi-bedroom apartments in high-rise buildings, with cutting-edge mid-rise buildings and renowned hotels. The community was designed to create a space pleasant for living, resting, and unwinding.

The location is distinguished by its abundance of green spaces, with numerous parks spread throughout the community, including dog parks and pet-friendly cafes. Three nurseries, a university, a school, a hospital, and a shopping mall are all within the area, ensuring all daily needs are met. Rental income in JVC is among the highest in Dubai, making it an attractive option for investors.

For those seeking a residence that embodies community living, green spaces, and strong investment potential, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of parks, amenities, and a prime Dubai address makes it one of the city's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can come home to a place they love.
